summary: Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2026-5C9 filed an 8-K regarding the entry into a Pooling and Servicing Agreement for a commercial mortgage-backed securities transaction. The issuer issued pass-through certificates representing beneficial ownership in a trust holding 29 fixed-rate mortgage loans and subordinate interests in two loans secured by 138 commercial properties. The filing notes a modification to the servicing arrangement for the ONX Industrial Campus Whole Loan. This is a routine securitization filing, not a special situation. The registrant is the depositor. No deal terms such as price per share or premium are applicable.
